tagline: Executing a clear strategy for sustainable performance and responsible finance
hero_kpi_rationale: The strong growth in net income in 2025, driven by a reduction in provisions and improved operational efficiency, reflects the successful execution of the banking group's sustainable performance strategy.

risks.title: Increased competition in the online banking market
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in section 1.4.1 with strong language on competitive pressure, particularly from BoursoBank. The trend is upward due to the expansion of neobanks. The Competition category is strategically central to the business.

risks.title: Dependence on external strategic partnerships
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly cites partnerships with AllianceBernstein and Brookfield as key (section 1.3). The language emphasizes their importance for value proposition. Dependence on these third parties constitutes a strategic operational risk in case of disruption. Trend stable.

risks.title: Increasing regulation on sustainable finance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is addressed in section 4.13 (ESG) with strong language on regulatory requirements. The trend is upward, reflecting increased regulatory pressure in Europe. This category is critical for modern banking operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity amid rising digitalization
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly stated in Item 1A, the risk is implicit in the large-scale digital transformation (BoursoBank, online services). The language on operational risk management (4.10) is intense. Trend rising. Category critical for banks.

risks.title: Geographic concentration in Central and Eastern Europe
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions Komerčni banka (Czech Republic) and BRD (Romania) as key assets (1.1). The language indicates significant exposure. Trend rising in a tense geopolitical context. Significant strategic risk.

risks.title: Dependence on ESG business performance
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights the MSCI ESG AAA rating (page 8) and sustainable finance targets. The language is positive, increasing reputational risk in case of setbacks. Trend stable.

risks.title: Organizational transformation and change management
risks.score_rationale: The renewal of Slawomir Krupa's mandate is announced (page 3), along with the simplification of operating models. The language is ambitious. Trend rising. Risk related to leadership continuity.

ai_positioning.summary: Societe Generale adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, focusing on limited operational use cases and efficiency gains. The absence of prominent AI mentions in the document suggests gradual integration rather than ambitious transformation.
evidence: No mention of major AI initiatives in the document
Priority given to sustainability and operational transformation
No reference to AI APIs, AI deals or call volumes
